text:
laura.sales: Acme needs a scoped API key for a 5-day POC, GH Actions + local dev. Can we provision today?

omar.se: Yep. Recommend TTL=120h, scope=generate+embeddings, no admin perms. Will we need IP allowlist?

laura.sales: Not for now. They run from GH Actions so dynamic IPs.

vivian.eng: I'll create a short-lived key and put the secret in Secrets Manager. Plan: create key, tag metadata (owner=laura.sales, project=acme-poc), enable audit logs retention=90d, schedule 48h CS reminder.

marta.cs: From sec questionnaire they want proof of audit logs and an easy revoke. Can you include revoke/rotate snippets?

vivian.eng: Done. Revoke (admin):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/admin/keys/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_API_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"key_id":"tok-acme-poc-2026-01"}'
```
Console: Admin > API Keys > search "tok-acme-poc-2026-01" > Revoke. Immediate invalidation.

vivian.eng: Rotation steps: create new key, update GH secret, smoke test, revoke old. Two keys may coexist during rollout.

omar.se: For CI best-practice note: recommend pulling secret from our Secrets Manager via a read-only integration token. For POC we'll hand the static key but call out the ephemeral flow for prod.

laura.sales: Please include a quick smoke curl snippet I can paste to Acme.

vivian.eng: Smoke test:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_POC_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1-small","input":"hello"}'
```

marta.cs: I'll add the audit retention note to the questionnaire answer and confirm contact info (laura.sales@redwood.com).

key-bot: Created key tok-acme-poc-2026-01, TTL=120h, scope=[generate,embeddings], owner=laura.sales. Secret stored at secret://acme/poc/key-2026-01. Audit logs enabled. 48h reminder scheduled.

laura.sales: Thanks — I'll send the onboarding email with the CLI + Console revoke steps and the smoke test. Close once email is out.

vivian.eng: Marked key with tags poc=true, project=acme-poc. If Acme requests auto-rotation we can revisit but will need CI changes.
